speaker: S1
text: 你好，这是 iPhone 14 本地同传测试。
expectedTranslation: Hello, this is an iPhone 14 local interpretation test.

speaker: S1
text: 今天下午三点我们开产品会议。
expectedTranslation: We will have a product meeting at three o'clock this afternoon.

speaker: S1
text: 请把会议纪要发给李明确认。
expectedTranslation: Please send the meeting notes to Li Ming for confirmation.

speaker: S1
text: 收货地址是北京市朝阳区建国路八十八号。
expectedTranslation: The delivery address is No. 88 Jianguo Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing.

speaker: S1
text: 请在周五前发送报关资料和发票。
expectedTranslation: Please send the customs declaration documents and invoice before Friday.

speaker: S1
text: 这个订单号是 A-120，请不要读错。
expectedTranslation: The order number is A-120. Please do not read it incorrectly.

speaker: S2
text: What is your name?
expectedTranslation: 你叫什么名字？

speaker: S2
text: Please send me the meeting notes after the product discussion.
expectedTranslation: 请在产品讨论结束后把会议纪要发给我。

speaker: S2
text: Please confirm the hotel address and invoice.
expectedTranslation: 请确认酒店地址和发票。

speaker: S2
text: The order number is A-120 and the price is twenty thousand yuan.
expectedTranslation: 订单号是 A-120，价格是两万元。

speaker: S2
text: I will call customer service after lunch.
expectedTranslation: 午饭后我会联系客服。

speaker: S2
text: Nice to meet you, Tianliang.
expectedTranslation: 很高兴见到你，天亮。

speaker: S1
text: 今天下午三点我们会讨论产品计划，会议结束以后我会整理会议纪要，并在下班前发给大家确认。
expectedTranslation: At three o'clock this afternoon, we will discuss the product plan. After the meeting, I will organize the meeting notes and send them to everyone for confirmation before the end of the day.

speaker: S1
text: 我们要重点测试中文长句在没有明显停顿的情况下，字幕是否完整，翻译是否会漏掉后半句。
expectedTranslation: We need to focus on testing whether Chinese long sentences remain complete without obvious pauses, and whether the translation misses the second half of the sentence.

speaker: S1
text: 如果环境里有人在旁边说话，系统应该优先识别离手机最近的主讲人，不要把背景声音当成字幕。
expectedTranslation: If someone is speaking nearby, the system should prioritize the main speaker closest to the phone and not treat background voices as captions.

speaker: S1
text: 这个版本需要在 iPhone 14 上连续运行三十分钟，观察电量、温度、字幕延迟和是否会出现端侧错误。
expectedTranslation: This version needs to run continuously on iPhone 14 for thirty minutes to observe battery, temperature, caption latency, and whether on-device errors occur.

speaker: S2
text: Today we are testing whether the iPhone 14 can run local speech recognition and translation without sending audio to the server.
expectedTranslation: 今天我们正在测试 iPhone 14 是否可以在不把音频发送到服务器的情况下运行本地语音识别和翻译。

speaker: S2
text: Please check if the first partial caption appears quickly and whether the final caption is delayed after I stop speaking.
expectedTranslation: 请检查第一个临时字幕是否快速出现，以及我停止说话后最终字幕是否延迟。

speaker: S2
text: If the network is turned off, the app should continue local transcription and clearly tell the user when translation packages are missing.
expectedTranslation: 如果网络关闭，应用应该继续本地转写，并在缺少翻译语言包时清楚地告诉用户。

speaker: S2
text: The meeting summary should highlight the action items, the owner, the deadline, and any numbers that must not be changed.
expectedTranslation: 会议总结应该突出行动项、负责人、截止日期以及任何不能被改动的数字。

speaker: S1
text: What's your name？你叫什么名字？
expectedTranslation: 你叫什么名字？ What is your name?

speaker: S1
text: This is an automatic language detection test，自动识别语言。
expectedTranslation: 这是一个自动语言检测测试。 Automatic language detection.

speaker: S1
text: 我们要测试 FireRedASR2，Hy-MT2 和 VoxCPM2 的在线模型链路。
expectedTranslation: We need to test the online model pipeline for FireRedASR2, Hy-MT2, and VoxCPM2.

speaker: S1
text: Please switch to 本地模式 and keep the subtitles on screen.
expectedTranslation: 请切换到 local mode，并保持字幕显示在屏幕上。

speaker: S1
text: The SKU A-120 的报价是两万元。
expectedTranslation: SKU A-120 的 quotation is twenty thousand yuan.

speaker: S1
text: Nemotron 识别中文，Whisper 作为备用。
expectedTranslation: Nemotron recognizes Chinese, and Whisper is used as a backup.

speaker: S1
text: 今天我们测试自动识别语言，重点看中文和英文快速切换时能不能自动反向翻译。
expectedTranslation: Today we are testing automatic language recognition, focusing on whether Chinese and English can be automatically translated in reverse during fast switching.

speaker: S1
text: 这句话会说得比较快，用来观察字幕是不是会丢字，或者把后面的内容合并到下一句。
expectedTranslation: This sentence will be spoken relatively fast to observe whether the captions drop words or merge the later content into the next sentence.

speaker: S1
text: 请记录首个字幕出现的时间，最终字幕出现的时间，以及翻译出来的时间。
expectedTranslation: Please record the time when the first caption appears, the time when the final caption appears, and the time when the translation appears.

speaker: S1
text: 如果这段话识别不完整，后面要降低端点检测阈值，或者延长缓冲窗口。
expectedTranslation: If this segment is not recognized completely, we need to lower the endpoint detection threshold or extend the buffer window later.

speaker: S1
text: 旁边有背景声音的时候，只识别我现在说的这句话。
expectedTranslation: When there is background sound nearby, only recognize the sentence I am saying now.

speaker: S2
text: Please ignore the background music and transcribe only this sentence.
expectedTranslation: 请忽略背景音乐，只转写这句话。

speaker: S1
text: 电视外放的声音不应该被当成新的翻译内容。
expectedTranslation: The sound from the TV speaker should not be treated as new translation content.

speaker: S1
text: 这是电话带宽测试，请确认八千赫兹音频还能识别清楚。
expectedTranslation: This is a phone bandwidth test. Please confirm that eight kilohertz audio can still be recognized clearly.

speaker: S2
text: This is a narrow band phone call test with reduced audio quality.
expectedTranslation: 这是一个音质降低的窄带电话测试。

speaker: S1
text: 请把这个电话号码一三八零零一三八零零零读完整。
expectedTranslation: Please read this phone number 13800138000 completely.

speaker: S2
text: The verification code is nine zero eight seven, please repeat it once.
expectedTranslation: 验证码是九零八七，请重复一遍。

speaker: S1
text: 我是第一个说话人，现在开始介绍产品计划。
expectedTranslation: I am the first speaker, and I will now start introducing the product plan.

speaker: S2
text: I am the second speaker, and I have a question about the timeline.
expectedTranslation: 我是第二个说话人，我有一个关于时间表的问题。

speaker: S3
text: 我是第三个说话人，请记录我的角色不要混淆。
expectedTranslation: I am the third speaker. Please record my role and do not confuse it.

speaker: S4
text: I am the fourth speaker and I will give the final conclusion.
expectedTranslation: 我是第四个说话人，我会给出最后结论。

speaker: S1
text: 现在关闭网络，测试本地语音识别和本地翻译是否还能继续。
expectedTranslation: Now turn off the network and test whether local speech recognition and local translation can continue.

speaker: S2
text: If the language package is missing, show a clear message instead of failing silently.
expectedTranslation: 如果缺少语言包，请显示清晰提示，不要静默失败。

speaker: S1
text: 请用系统语音朗读这句翻译，检查首音延迟和可懂度。
expectedTranslation: Please read this translation with the system voice and check first-audio latency and intelligibility.

speaker: S2
text: Please speak the translated sentence clearly at normal volume.
expectedTranslation: 请用正常音量清楚地朗读翻译后的句子。
